caption:
Three legal, boring, completely normal ways small business owners reduce their tax.

1. Assets under $20,000 can be written off in full in the year they're first used or installed ready for use (turnover under $10M; now permanent from 1 July 2026).
2. Small businesses can deduct prepaid expenses now if the service period is 12 months or less and ends by the end of next financial year.
3. Sole traders and partners in small businesses get the small business income tax offset: 16% off the tax on business income, up to $1,000 a year.

Save this for June.

General info only, not personal advice.
